purpose: Ground-truth reference events for later P1/profile correlation. These events are not yet used as automatic detection rules.

events.p1_correlation_note: Around 04:45Z the day series shows ~2.34 kW net import, but boilerOn=true and L2 is ~2.23 kW. Therefore this sample cannot be attributed reliably to the oven.
Around 04:45-04:55Z the 5-minute history is only ~0.30 kW net import. The finish notification therefore does not coincide with a visible high-power oven sample in the current 5-minute series.

implementation_rule: Do not classify oven use from these timestamps alone. Require a repeated power/phase signature across multiple clean reference events before enabling automatic classification.
architecture_note: Use existing EM v2 history/P1 data; do not add extra Homey polling solely for oven detection.
